verdict.rationale: Loops lets developers author email content as code in LMX through the Content API, which stays in sync with the visual editor (loops-docs-9, -26, -44, -46). Dynamic variables such as {contact.firstName} resolve per recipient at send time, and transactional sends accept data variables (loops-docs-45, -34). The API covers email content and themes, and migration examples show templates rebuilt in LMX via the Content API (loops-docs-37, -14). missing for 10: explicit documentation of a version-control or git-based template workflow, raw HTML/MJML import support, clarity on whether API-created campaigns must still be reviewed and sent from the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
